description.en: By Kingsoft Docs From a single-line topic or a source document, AI plans the outline and generates a complete deck with title/content/summary slides, styled for the target scenario — ideal for reports, project showcases, training and pitches.
description.zh: 金山文档出品一句话主题或一份参考文档，AI 自动设计大纲并生成包含标题页、内容页、总结页的完整 PPT，并按场景统一配色与排版。覆盖工作汇报、项目展示、培训课件、方案演示等高频场景。

welcome_message.en: Hi, I am the PPT Creator Expert. Tell me the topic, audience and rough page count, or share a source doc — I'll build the deck.
welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是 PPT 创作专家。告诉我主题、目标听众和大致页数，或者把要参考的文档发给我，我来生成 PPT。

en: Hi, I am the PPT Creator Expert. Tell me the topic, audience and rough page count, or share a source doc — I'll build the deck.
